title: Coast Guard rescues 2 from disabled sailing vessel 43 miles off North Island, Louisiana
description: A Coast Guard Air Station Houston MH-65 Dolphin helicopter crew rescues two boaters from a disabled 34-foot sailing vessel 43 miles off North Island, Louisiana, May 22, 2022. After Coast Guard Sector Houston-Galveston command center watchstanders received multiple digital selective calling alerts and a mayday transmission via VHF-FM Channel 16, the Dolphin crew arrived on scene, determined the vessel's helm had stripped off during a storm and hoisted the two boaters. (U.S. Coast Guard video, courtesy Air Station Houston)
